arguments.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: single transparent cartoon game sprite SMDATE1.BMP 000. Redraw image 1's exact pose, silhouette, visible fragments and motion in the polished cartoon style of images 2-4. Image 1 is the authoritative original pixel-art source, enlarged with nearest-neighbor; do not preserve its pixel stair steps or red-white dithering. Images 2 and 3 establish the same adult mermaid's yellow hair, cyan headband, warm peach skin, green swimsuit and green fish tail; image 4 establishes the forked fin design. They provide style and identity only, never substitute their poses.
Frame-specific subject: Only the top of the adult mermaid's head is visible emerging above the waterline: yellow hair rising to a small peak at upper left, cyan band across the upper head, face peeking at lower right looking to screen right and slightly down. Preserve the short triangular silhouette. The entire body, shoulders, arms and tail are underwater and invisible. Do not invent torso.
Style: clean smooth bold black cartoon outlines, saturated colors, restrained cel shading, readable anatomy and motion. White water foam with cyan outlines and a few cyan shadows matches the approved references. Preserve adult human upper-body proportions, anatomical hands when visible, and the original hidden or underwater regions. Do not add body parts that are absent from source.
Composition: one complete isolated sprite, source-relative silhouette and orientation preserved, centered with modest transparent margin; no other frame, montage, label, text or watermark. Actual transparent RGBA background, including empty gaps between splash strokes. No checkerboard baked in, no opaque background, no horizon or ocean scene.
